name: Red Light / Green Light
setup: Every kid has a ball at one end. Coach at the other end.
howToPlay: Green light: dribble toward the coach. Red light: stop with the sole of the foot on top of the ball. Yellow light: slow, tiny touches. Purple light: turn around.
coachingPoints: Small touches so the ball stays close
Stop with the foot on top, not a kick
story: You're race cars and the coach is the traffic light.

name: Sharks & Minnows
setup: Minnows with balls on one side of a 15x15 box. One or two sharks (start with a coach) without a ball in the middle.
howToPlay: Minnows dribble across without a shark kicking their ball out. Kicked-out minnows become sharks. Last minnow wins and is the first shark next round.
coachingPoints: Head up to see the sharks
Change direction to dodge

name: Pirate Treasure
setup: Scatter every ball in the middle. Each kid or pair has a 'ship' (hoop) on the edge.
howToPlay: On go, kids dribble one treasure ball at a time back to their ship, then run for another. Coach steals treasure back for round two.
coachingPoints: Keep the ball close
Use both feet

name: Knock the Castle
setup: Build 4–6 cone castles across the area. Kids start 5 yards away with a ball.
howToPlay: Shoot to knock the castles down. Coach rebuilds fast. Count castles together at the end.
coachingPoints: Plant foot next to the ball
Kick with the laces, not the toe
story: The dragon's castles need to fall.

name: Body-Part Ball
setup: Kids dribble freely in a box.
howToPlay: Coach calls a body part (knee, elbow, bottom, nose). Kids stop their ball with that part as fast as possible. Then back to dribbling.
coachingPoints: Listen while dribbling
Stop the ball, then touch it

name: Freeze Tag with a Ball
setup: Everyone dribbles in a box. Coach is the tagger (no ball).
howToPlay: Tagged kids freeze with legs wide, ball in hands overhead. A teammate unfreezes them by passing a ball through their legs.
coachingPoints: Look up to find who needs help
Pass with the inside of the foot

name: Egg Hunt
setup: Coach scatters every ball far and wide.
howToPlay: Kids dribble eggs back to the nest one at a time. Coach keeps throwing them back out. Pure chaos, pure dribbling.
coachingPoints: Dribble, don't carry
Little touches
story: Bring the eggs home before the fox gets them.

name: Animal Dribble
setup: Open space, every kid a ball.
howToPlay: Coach calls an animal: elephant (slow, big touches), cheetah (fast, small touches), crab (sideways with the sole), kangaroo (hop over the ball).
coachingPoints: Change speed on command
Use the sole to move sideways
story: We're a zoo on the loose.

name: Coach Says
setup: Kids in a loose circle, each with a ball.
howToPlay: Coach Says: toe taps, sole rolls, pull-backs, sit on the ball, jump over the ball. Skip the 'you're out' rule; everyone keeps playing.
coachingPoints: Feel the ball with different parts of the foot

name: Big Goal Scrimmage
setup: 3v3 or 4v4, no keepers, small goals. Two coaches stand at the sides with spare balls.
howToPlay: Just play. When a ball goes out, a coach rolls a new one in immediately. The only instruction: 'which goal is ours'. No score.
coachingPoints: Go score!
Cheer effort, not goals

name: 1v1 Through the Gates
setup: Pairs, 4–6 cone gates scattered in a box.
howToPlay: Attacker tries to dribble through any gate; defender tries to win it. Swap on every score or steal.
coachingPoints: Change speed to beat the defender
Attack the space away from the defender

name: Throwing Station: Knock Down the Cans
howToPlay: Each kid throws to knock the cones down. Step with the opposite foot.
coachingPoints: Point the glove at the target
Step and throw

name: Hitting Station: Tee Time
setup: One hitter at a time, others field with gloves 20 feet away.
howToPlay: Five swings each, then rotate. Fielders roll balls back to the bucket.
coachingPoints: Feet apart, knees bent
Watch the ball hit the bat

name: Base Running Race
setup: Kids line up at home in two short lines (max 3 each).
howToPlay: Run the bases on 'go'. Touch every base. High-five the coach at home.
coachingPoints: Touch every base
Run through first
